title: Control nodes bought at Node Gamma for 410 cr or less, sold into Factory Belt's bid at 700 or more: a trade test beyond the border
note: 2026-11-21 23:50 UTC (Mercury, orders.log ENT-059 block MERCURY: trade beyond our borders). Node Gamma asks control node 398 x 100 (112 in all; book of 23:3x UTC, table books); Factory Belt Manufacturing Hub (22 jumps, 14 of them lawless: scripts/map.py route node_gamma factory_belt) bids 777 x 200 (book read 0.3 h before). About 375 cr a unit after the buyer's 1 percent: 24,400 cr a Threshold load of 65, 37,500 a freighter load of 100 (gaps.py, skill trade-books). Size 1 a unit. A test: one ship (max_ships 1), an empty hold out of home, the buy gated by requires.ask (a book of Node Gamma read within the hour) and the sale by requires.bid; stop_on_failed_buy ends the run at Node Gamma when the ask is gone, so no ship flies 22 jumps empty. What the bid leaves is stored at Factory Belt. Pirates: kitalpha on the road had 16 battles since 2026-11-15, the last 2026-11-21 11:28 UTC (observations kind pirate); no ship of ours lost in the store's 8 days (stats_pilot_hour). Whether Node Gamma's ask and Factory Belt's bid come back decides if this repeats.
